description: Supply-chain rails: updates batched weekly, no auto-merge, 3-day release cooldown. Inert until the Mend/Renovate GitHub App is installed on the repo.

packageRules.description: Batch non-major updates into one weekly PR.

The @canton-network/* SDK graph is pinned in pnpm-workspace.yaml (dapp-sdk 1.1.0) and updated by hand when we choose to. Disabled so Renovate never proposes or nags SDK bumps; re-enable, or bump the pins manually, to update.
Hold TypeScript major bumps (v7 is the new Go-native compiler; see closed PR #24) until we choose to adopt. Minor/patch within the current major still flow via the weekly batch.
